report.paragraph: Revision: 22 October 2026, C006 Pier Wall, Hairpins and Fin Plates withdrawn (T040, D-082): by user direction the fin-plate and hairpin hanger calculation is sequestered from the project (kept intact in the repository under sequestered/ for revival) and its module is removed from the journal; the welded annular-ring calculation C017 is the pier-wall support calculation the project carries, matching the CAD model (D-076, D-079). Calculation numbers are permanent identifiers from this revision on: C006 stays retired like C005, no calculation is renumbered, and the index heading spans the numbers in use. C017 is regenerated from its unchanged starting case with the same definitions, values, caches and figures; only its hidden working notes and the "Outside this calculation" sentence no longer present C006 as the undecided alternative. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed; no engineering value changed.

Revision: 22 October 2026, C018 Pier Cap Cheek Wall Design added (T038): the two pier cap cheek walls of the CAD model (48 x 48 x 12 in with the recessed panel; centred #4 mat at 10 in each way, verticals developed 12 in straight into the cap) enter the journal as their own calculation, generated from the Pier Cheek Wall Design notebook package (pier_cheek_wall, calc_common framework) by scripts/build_pier_cheek_wall.py on its starting case: wind directly on the walls per LRFD 3.8.1.2.1 and 3.8.1.2.3b with the C001 wind speeds, exposure coefficient and gust factor as live references and the C002 substructure drag coefficient; the wall as a cantilever from the cap top checked for flexure, minimum flexure, shear, interface shear, crack control, straight development, shrinkage and temperature steel, spacing, cover and thickness. 183 native definitions, 174 values compared with the notebook to 1 part in 10⁹, live project stamp and hidden working notes. Every numerical check passes; the development and the cover sit exactly at their limits and the one-centred-mat shrinkage and temperature convention is pending confirmation. The project record selects the same run as CHEEK-TOOL, CHEEK-REPORT and CHEEK-CASE (D-081). The module is appended here and moved after C017 by T039. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed; no existing value changed.

Revision: 22 October 2026, pier wall ring plate 1/2 in (T037): by user direction the annular pile-ring plate of C017 Pier Wall, Annular Pile Rings is 1/2 in thick in place of 3/4 in. The thicker plate was not strength-governed (plate bending 0.05 of capacity); the thinnest standard plate with every check at or under 0.95 of its limit is 7/16 in, set by the maximum fillet at the ring edge with the 5/16-in fillet, and the user selected 1/2 in. C017 is regenerated from the second 22 October starting case: ring diameters, fillets, wall, forces, rotation, ring moment, contact and bearing unchanged from the previous revision; plate bending 0.11 and the fillet 0.08 of capacity; 1 failed check, grid clearance, as before. The CAD model rings are 3/4 in until reconciled. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed.

Revision: 22 October 2026, pier modules follow the 22 October FBMP rerun (T036, D-077): the user’s rerun Pier_Fixed.XML (SHA-256 420e614aa8b9…) corrects the pier wall extra members, which had followed the soil elevation changes: the four vertical 36 x 60 in pier wall members between the pile nodes now span pile points 2 to 11 (EL 40.20 to the soil surface EL 26.05, 169.8 in, 127.3 kip in all) in place of points 2 to 13 (EL 19.72, 245.8 in, 184.4 kip in all); nodal and bearing loads, geometry, pile section and material, soil and the four load combinations are identical. C010 Pier Cap Design and C013 Pier Pile Design are replaced by their regenerated journal editions (the cap edition from the 10-22 report with nine force inputs moved and no status change; the pile edition with the demands of the new export, structural D/C 0.464, 11 pending items). FBMP Entry - Pier, Foundations and FBMP Modeling and Bridge Geometry record the new export identity. End-bent modules unchanged. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed.

Revision: 22 October 2026, pier wall reconciled to the CAD geometry (T034): by user direction the CAD pier wall governs, 219 in long, 36 in thick, bottom 1 ft below terrain at EL 24.5264 ft and top at the cap bottom EL 40.76494 ft (194.8625 in high), 19.5 in from each wall end to the outer pile; the gravity sheet row 42 (Loads - Gravity - 2 Beam) carries that wall (wall weight 114.737 to 133.359 kip), C006 Pier Wall, Hairpins and Fin Plates and C004 Superstructure Uplift are regenerated by their notebook packages with the new values (C004 shows the wall weight for information only; no result changes), and C017 Pier Wall, Annular Pile Rings is regenerated from the 22 October starting case (free length to fixity 92.4 in from the wall bottom in place of 127 in from the pile cutoff; 1 failed check, grid clearance; the former end-cover failure was an artefact of the 213-in length). The FBMP pier model keeps its pile-row wall load from the 114.7 kip wall (the CAD wall is 133.4 kip gross; recorded for the next rerun decision), C002 keeps the cap-face wind area, and the geometry notebook does not yet own the pier wall. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed.

Revision: 21 October 2026, code-reference modules retired (T031): the four modules C001 - References to C004 - References (GetRefs code excerpts) are removed from the journal. Every provision cited by C001 to C004, C006, C015 and C016 now opens as a citation card with the highlighted code excerpt in the calculation report of its notebook package; the journal keeps the distilled calculation editions with their citations as plain text. The General References module keeps its own pages and its index; entries that pointed into the retired modules are listed without links. No formula, cache, value or figure changed.

Revision: 21 October 2026, C008 End Bent 1 Cap Design and C009 End Bent 2 Cap Design replaced by their regenerated journal editions (T033): the registered End Bent cap reports are the 20 October re-exports from the unchanged cases (D-068, definition and citation cards), and the editions now name them; every definition, cached value and canvas is identical to the prior modules. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed; no value changed.

Revision: 21 October 2026, pier modules follow the 21 October FBMP rerun (T032, D-073): the user’s rerun Pier_Fixed.XML (SHA-256 8be45bb889f5…) changes only the pipe pile material, ASTM A252 Grade 3 at Fy 45 ksi in place of 60 ksi; nodal loads, geometry, pile section, soil and load combinations are those of the 19 October export. C010 Pier Cap Design and C013 Pier Pile Design are replaced by their regenerated journal editions (the cap edition from the 10-21 report with every force envelope, ratio and status unchanged; the pile edition with every demand and resistance unchanged, structural D/C 0.457, and the steel-grade prerequisite source-backed by the export, 11 pending items in place of 16). Pile Section Properties, FBMP Entry - Pier, Foundations and FBMP Modeling and Bridge Geometry record the new export identity and the 45 ksi material. End-bent modules unchanged. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed; no existing definition or cached value changed.

Revision: 21 October 2026, C017 Pier Wall, Annular Pile Rings added (T028): the welded annular-ring support concept of the pier wall (minimum wall steel and detailing; full annular contact, concrete bearing, plate bending and shear, two continuous fillets and adjacent base metal at every ring) enters the journal as its own calculation, generated from the Pier Wall Design notebook package (ring_wall) by scripts/build_ring_wall_bpad.py on its starting case: 673 ledger values and 178 check statuses as native definitions, each evaluated independently and compared with the notebook to 1 part in 10⁹, with the live project stamp and hidden working notes. Ring moment basis D-070 (pile-head compatibility moment; placement tolerance as pile-group redistribution; the former tributary-eccentricity moment kept for comparison); pile stiffness defaults from the pier pile case. C006 (fin plates and hairpins) is unchanged; which support concept governs is undecided. The module is appended here and moved after C016 by T029. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed; no existing value changed.

Revision: 21 October 2026, notebook editions of C001 to C004, C006, C015 and C016 (T027): the seven calculations that had no Colab notebook are now generated from their notebooks (packages wind_superstructure, fence_wind, bridge_movement, superstructure_uplift, pier_wall_fins, mse_wall_exclusion and bearing_design on the shared calc_common framework). Each notebook was run with the journal values; every definition of the former hand-authored module was evaluated independently from the journal file and reproduced by the notebook to 1 part in 10⁹ before its journal edition was written. The editions keep the report names, the C-number titles, the names other modules read (as live references passed through the coherence gate), the native figures, the design-basis prose with its anchors and the live project stamp; the per-equation notes, step navigation and echoed value displays are distilled out (they remain in the notebook reports). C016 omits the eleven superseded D-064/D-065 status strings (recorded in its working notes); C015 keeps its two knife-edge SHORTFALL rows. Native recalculation, appearance and engineering reviews not performed; no engineering value changed.

Revision: 20 October 2026, project stamp and module order (T024): the pile calculations C011 to C013 open with the live project stamp like every other calculation; the modules are ordered basis first, then C001 to C016 in numerical order (reference packets after their calculations), then quantities, decisions, notes, references and archives; the index groups the calculations the same way.

Revision: 20 October 2026, submission formatting (T022): the calculation modules are numbered C007 to C016 (cap design basis C007, cap designs C008 to C010, pile designs C011 to C013, end-bent backwall C014, MSE wall exclusion C015, bearings and support details C016; C005 stays retired); the working language of each calculation (provenance, tool status, pending items, decision and task identifiers) sits in hidden WorkingNotes sections; table text is in multiline cells; "distilled" no longer appears in titles or visible text. No formula, cache or value changed.

Revision: 19 October 2026, end-bent backwall report added (T017): EndBentBackwallDesign, the distilled 19 October 2026 backwall, cheek-wall and tie-back strap case (D-057) with live references to BridgeGeometry_2Beam, Materials and ProjectInfo.

Revision: 19 October 2026, coherence with the 19 October calculations and CAD model (T016): D-049 exports, D-051 cap reports and D-054 pile reports recorded as current; end-bent design record refreshed; MSE exclusion wall lines re-extracted from the D-055 model; notebook check retargeted to build e9b41b8eaf.

Revision: 8 October 2026, coherence responses. End-bent input uses loaded nodes 15 and 34, 103-in bearing spacing and a 42-in-wide by 36-in-deep cap. Both end bents follow the controlling configuration. End-bent pedestals are 30 in long; pier pedestals remain 48 in. Deferred wall quantities and remaining design checks are identified in the current record.
